card_text: Haircuts booked from Hobbs: fitting the cut around a Lea County work week and the drive west.

seo.title: Men's Haircuts for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Men's haircuts for Hobbs clients, cut in Carlsbad west on US 62/180. Fitting the Essential, Signature or Luxury around a Lea County work week.

paragraphs: I cut hair in Carlsbad, at {{address}}, which puts my chair about {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles west of Hobbs on {{city:hobbs.route}}. Call it {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes each way (OpenStreetMap routing), so a haircut from Hobbs is an afternoon, not an errand.
Three haircut services are on my Booksy menu. This page is about picking the one that earns that drive.

blocks.heading: Cut around the schedule, not the other way.
paragraphs: Census ACS 2023 puts {{city:hobbs.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} of Hobbs jobs in mining, oil and ag, a higher share than Carlsbad's {{city:carlsbad.mining_ag_jobs_pct}}. If your week runs on a rotation, a Saturday slot may be the one that holds: I'm open 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and an early time gets you back to Hobbs before the afternoon.

The average Hobbs commute is already {{city:hobbs.commute_min}} minutes (Census ACS 2023). Put the trip to Carlsbad on top of that and you can see why I'd rather you book once and leave with a cut that lasts.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The cut on its own, shaped to your head, neck cleaned with a straight razor. If you keep your own beard, this is the one.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Haircut plus a beard trim or line-up, a hot towel and razor detailing. The beard is handled in the same appointment.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Consultation, cut, beard sculpt, wash and scalp massage, steam, two hot towels, a basic design, ear and nose wax, fragrance. The booking that does the most in one sitting.

blocks.heading: Get the most out of the chair.
paragraphs: Driving {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes for a {{minutes:essential-haircut}} haircut is a fair trade for some people. If it isn't for you, book the Luxury, or add the wash, eyebrows or a design to the Essential or Signature from Booksy's add-on list.
Before you leave, grab your next date. Weekday appointments run Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday; I'm closed Wednesday and Sunday.

items.q: Which haircut service should I book from Hobbs?
items.a: The Essential if you only want the cut, the Signature if your beard needs attention too, and the Luxury Grooming Experience if you want the trip to cover everything.

items.q: How long is the drive from Hobbs to the shop?
items.a: About {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles west on {{city:hobbs.route}}, roughly {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes (OpenStreetMap routing).

items.q: Can I get a Saturday haircut?
items.a: Yes. Saturday runs 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM, by appointment on Booksy. Book ahead; the slot you see on Booksy is the one you get.
